title: veld.toml
description: Veld 2 workspace configuration: a root file with `[workspace]`, one file per member with `[service]`, `[app]` or `[library]`, or one file with a single member. Unknown keys are errors (E0701).

workspace.description: The workspace root: the project name, its members and what they share.

description.description: A one-line description of the project.

members.description: Member directories relative to the root, with `/`. A segment may be `*`. No other pattern syntax exists.

exclude.description: Directories that are not members, whatever `members` says.

prefix.description: Route prefix such as `/api`, prepended to every service prefix. Must start with `/`.

defaults.description: `[workspace.defaults.<role>.<emitter>]`: the `framework` and option keys a target of that role and emitter starts from. A key the member writes replaces the default.

service.description: A service. Its contracts are one package. It may hold `[server]` and `[client]` targets.

name.description: The name of the service: what `use <name>:...` and `consumes` refer to. Default: the directory name; required in a root file.

contracts.description: The directory holding the `.veld` files, relative to this `veld.toml`. Default `contracts`.

prefix.description: Route prefix such as `/v1`, prepended to this service's prefixes after `[workspace].prefix`. Must start with `/`.

base-url.description: Default base URL of the service for generated clients (lower priority than the constructor argument and `VELD_<SERVICE>_URL`).

consumes.description: Services this service calls (`*` is every other service). Each must exist (E0702). Cycles are allowed. A server target generates a client for each one under `<out>/clients/<service>/`.

owners.description: Free-form names (teams, handles, addresses) shown by `veld diff` and `veld check --graph=json`. Never part of the IR or of generated code.

description.description: Short description shown in the registry.

app.description: An app: it consumes services and holds `[client]` targets. It has no contracts and no server.

name.description: The name of the app: what `use <name>:...` and `consumes` refer to. Default: the directory name; required in a root file.

uses.description: The services the app's clients cover. Each must exist (E0702). Default: every service of the workspace.

owners.description: Free-form names (teams, handles, addresses) shown by `veld diff` and `veld check --graph=json`. Never part of the IR or of generated code.

library.description: A shared contract package, importable as `use <name>:<module>.{Name}`. It has no targets.

name.description: The name of the library: what `use <name>:...` and `consumes` refer to. Default: the directory name; required in a root file.

contracts.description: The directory holding the `.veld` files, relative to this `veld.toml`. Default `contracts`.

owners.description: Free-form names (teams, handles, addresses) shown by `veld diff` and `veld check --graph=json`. Never part of the IR or of generated code.

description.description: Short description shown in the registry.

oneOf.description: A server target: an emitter and an output directory. The role is the table name.

name.description: Name used by `veld generate <name>` and for the package name `@veld/<name>`. Default: the member's name, `<member>-server` or `<member>-client` when the member has both; required when a member has several targets of one role.

emitter.description: A built-in emitter (`node`, `typescript`, `java`, `rust`) or `plugin:<name>` naming a `[plugins.<name>]` entry.

framework.description: The framework of the target. Valid values depend on emitter and role (E0803 lists them): node server `express`, `fastify`, `hono`, `node-http`, `nest`; typescript client `react`, `vue`; java server `jdk`, `spring`; rust server `axum`, rust client `reqwest`, `ureq`.

out.description: Output directory, relative to the member's directory. Default: `src/generated` (node, typescript), `src/main/java` (java), `generated` (rust); a plugin has none. Two targets must not share one (E0703); it must not be the workspace root or a contracts directory (E0704).

clients.description: Server targets only: set `false` to skip the generated clients for consumed services.

app.description: The directory of the app that consumes the output, relative to the member, for `veld setup`. Default: the nearest ancestor of `out` with a `package.json`, `pom.xml` or `build.gradle[.kts]`.

options.description: Emitter-specific options, checked against the emitter's typed options. An unknown key is E0802.

java.description: `java` emitter: the language version (default `17`, the oldest supported).

framework-version.description: The framework version: `spring` `"3"`, `nest` `"10"`, `react` `"18"`, `vue` `"3"`. Needs a `framework`; unversioned frameworks reject it (E0803).

transport.description: `rust` server: the HTTP transport of the clients for consumed services.

validate.description: `node`, `typescript`, `java` and `rust` emitters: `false` skips run-time request validation by default and keeps the types.

items.description: A server target: an emitter and an output directory. The role is the table name.

plugins.description: Generator plugins. Allowed only in the workspace root.

additionalProperties.description: A generator plugin, started over the plugin protocol (`spec/plugin-protocol.md`).

command.description: Executable, resolved on PATH or relative to `veld.toml`.

entry.description: Optional script an interpreter `command` runs; its path is appended to the command.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of `entry` if set, else of the executable. A mismatch is refused (E0705).

registry.description: The package registry. Allowed only in the workspace root.

url.description: Registry URL. Must be https except for localhost; `--registry` and `VELD_REGISTRY` override it.

dependencies.description: Registry packages, resolved and pinned in `veld.lock`. Allowed only in the workspace root.

lint.description: Lint rule levels (`off`, `warn`, `error`). Every rule defaults to `warn`; `veld check` reports them.

post-generate.description: Shell command(s) run from the project root after a successful, non-dry-run `veld generate` (for example `prettier --write gen`).

fail.description: Make a failing hook fail `veld generate`. By default a failure is only a warning.
